ibn_hisham.title: The Sirah of Ibn Hisham

ibn_hisham.edition: Ferdinand Wüstenfeld, Göttingen, 1858–1860: Arabic text in two parts (1858 and 1859), followed by introduction, notes and index (1860). Digital scan must be collated against the printed pagination.
ibn_hisham.rightsNote: Wikisource marks its facsimile as public domain; Qatar National Library records “No Known Copyright” for this edition. The Internet Archive OCR is heavily corrupted and will not be embedded without page-by-page correction.
